formulaLayout.short: one intact equality per row; center whole group
formulaLayout.transform: aligned relation columns for an actual equality chain only
formulaLayout.independent: separate rows, no equal sign inserted between different substitutions or cases
formulaLayout.inequalities: keep each original inequality as a condition; connect transformations by implication/equivalence only
formulaLayout.numbering: one number per result group, stable ID; collide -> existing label-only trailing row
formulaLayout.slot: compose template and blank as one mathematical subtree; fraction/radical fragments cannot be rendered independently

pagination.active: one small thought step; not full unit at once
pagination.history: collapse established work, expand on demand; never show future answer
pagination.resize: measure actual controls/answers after font settle and on resize; no future answer measurements
